source.stem:
Three statements about diamond, graphite and silicon(IV) oxide are listed. Which statements are correct?

1  Diamond and graphite both have giant covalent structures.
2  In silicon(IV) oxide, silicon and oxygen atoms are joined together by covalent bonds throughout the whole structure.
3  Diamond and silicon(IV) oxide have similar structures.

statements.text: Diamond and graphite both have giant covalent structures.
In silicon(IV) oxide, silicon and oxygen atoms are joined together by covalent bonds throughout the whole structure.
Diamond and silicon(IV) oxide have similar structures.

intelligence.enrichment: Natural factors can break down and move rocks, soil, and sediments; use the new-substance test to decide whether the change is physical or chemical. Wind, rain, and other natural forces act on rocks, soil, and sediments, causing weathering or erosion that forms smaller materials or moves them. The learner explains slow natural changes by identifying what natural forces do and then using the new-substance test for physical or chemical classification. Slow natural changes in rocks are chemical because they happen over many years.
